newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 16.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday April 16, 1997. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Air Ivoire may have found a way to restructure debt on its two Fokker planes by selling one of them.
-Ivorian forestry union holds its first congress to discuss conservation and protection.
-Campus troubles continue after allegations by a girl student at the University of Bouake of mistreatment by police.
-The Ivorian private sector says the West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA) must harmonise taxes before there can be free trade in goods and services.
